WITH subpar AS (
    SELECT audregistry, auddevref, audperfref, sndleveldb, sndsig, noiseisodb, audlatms, micsensedb, micfreqresp, spkimpohm, spksensedb, thdpct, freqresp, drvszmm, surrsnd, eqcount, micmon, noisecanc, btversion, btrangem, btlatms, multidev, autoslpmin, wakems,
